title: AdProof AI — Three-minute production walkthrough
disclosure: Edited walkthrough of actual production results. Fictional QA inputs. Saved reports are identified; no mocked provider output.

scenes.title: A claim is more than a score
scenes.caption: Audit → Repair → independent Verify
scenes.narration: AdProof AI helps small brands review advertising claims, repair a creative, and inspect what changed. Meta models support a traceable evidence workflow. A higher score alone never approves an edit.

scenes.title: Start with facts
scenes.caption: Fictional QA product · real production model results
scenes.narration: This fictional bottle has supplied facts: stainless steel, six hundred milliliters, and a screw cap. No fact establishes twenty four hours of cooling. The recording shows real production model results.

scenes.title: Inspect the source
scenes.caption: Muse Spark · readable claims and recorded evidence
scenes.narration: Muse Spark reads the creative and compares concrete claims with supplied facts. Claim X Ray keeps each observation beside its actual source image, without inventing location boxes or treating the advertisement as proof.

scenes.title: Follow the evidence
scenes.caption: Proof Constellation · source-linked observations
scenes.narration: Proof Constellation connects a claim with its recorded fact quotation, assessment, and repair advice. A quotation proves wording was supplied, not independent product truth. Unlinked findings and uncertainty remain visible.

scenes.title: Repair the creative
scenes.caption: Source-bound corrections · original and revision retained
scenes.narration: Repair addresses evidenced problems while protecting correct copy and product details. Safe text areas can use source pixels and OCR; complex changes use Muse Image. This recorded result removes unsupported duration and related wording.

scenes.title: Verify independently
scenes.caption: Recorded independent Meta comparison · source JSON
scenes.narration: Verify compares the revision with its original through a separate Muse Spark request. It checks text, new claims, product identity, branding, and active locks. Failed comparisons keep the revised export blocked.

scenes.title: Track every observed change
scenes.caption: Claim DNA · inspect retained, changed and missing observations
scenes.narration: Claim DNA relates model observations across the audits. Missing from a short claim list does not prove removal. The comparison slider lets reviewers inspect the actual before and after pixels alongside the evidence.

scenes.title: Choose a style deliberately
scenes.caption: 12 options · 7 locks · explicit model action
scenes.narration: Twelve styles and seven consistency locks guide deliberate edits. Choosing a preset makes no model call. Applying a style uses Muse Image, followed by independent verification. Locks guide the request, but every result still needs review.

scenes.title: Check the actual output
scenes.caption: Native pixels measured · interpolation adds no detail
scenes.narration: Choose Social Media, Website, or Print. Check Output renders locally and reports actual PNG dimensions, without hidden generation retries. Interpolation requires explicit permission and adds no native detail.

scenes.title: Adapt the composition
scenes.caption: Website and print · independent format comparison
scenes.narration: Composition adaptation creates a new aspect ratio and compares it independently. Recorded Website downloads are sixteen hundred by nine hundred, and nineteen twenty by ten eighty. Print options report physical size and density.

scenes.title: Save the evidence and continue
scenes.caption: JSON reports · image ZIP archives · no model call on import
scenes.narration: JSON saves observations and provenance. ZIP also keeps available images and history. Import makes no model call. Explicitly rechecking a saved pair uses one audit request, without generating the image again.

scenes.title: Inspect the proof
scenes.caption: adproof-ai.vercel.app · public source and evidence
scenes.narration: AdProof AI brings the creative, supplied facts, model evidence, revisions, and export limits into one inspectable workspace. Real production evidence and source code are public. Human review remains essential. Follow the proof.
